task: The hash plugin answers hash queries: `GET /search?q=sha256 abc&format=json` returns HTTP 200 with a JSON body whose `answers` list contains an answer stating the SHA-256 digest of `abc`, `ba7816bf8f01cfea414140de5dae2223b00361a396177a9cb410ff61f20015ad`.
A JSON search with an empty query is rejected: `GET /search?q=&format=json` (the `q` parameter present but empty) answers HTTP 400 with a JSON body whose `error` field is `No query`.

The RSS output format declares an XML media type: `GET /search?q=test&format=rss` answers HTTP 200 with a `Content-Type` header that names an XML media type (for example `text/xml`), and its body is an RSS 2.0 document (`<rss version="2.0">` with a `<channel>` titled `SearXNG search: test`).

Saved preferences persist across visits: a client that submits the preferences form (`POST /preferences`, form fields such as `simple_style=dark` and `method=POST`) is redirected to the home page, and when it later requests `GET /preferences` with the cookies it received, the page shows its choices selected (the `simple_style` option `dark` and the `method` option `POST` marked `selected`) instead of the defaults.

The instance configuration endpoint lists the enabled engines: `GET /config` returns HTTP 200 with a JSON body whose `engines` array contains exactly one engine, named `demo offline` with shortcut `demo`, `enabled` true and categories `["general"]`.
